support_policy: 10.0.0 development; version fields still record the 9.0.0 baseline. API1.4 is proposed and has no frozen tag. Existing tunnel management retains API v1 compatibility; new remote features require advertised server/host capabilities and a verified same-source dual-ABI SDK candidate. Native files, system audio and session continuation are implemented, with final package, full remote, UI and arm64 runtime coverage still pending. FRP retains its upstream version.
